title: Ya ali maula, haider maula
body:
Ya ali maula, haider maula
Ya ali maula, haider maula
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x5
Dil me sajaa ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
Dil me sajaa ke rakha hai
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula-e kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2 Har maula ye kehta hai (Ya ali maula, haider maula) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Bigri banaa de aye sawali, koyi na jaaye khali) x2
Aaje gadiri jaame pilaa de (Ay waliyo ke wali) x2
Teri ankhe mere mawla (Subko dekhne wali) x2
Chashme karam ne teri mawla, gamse bachaa ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Nagri, nagri, tere mawali, tere kalandar mawla) x2
Dharti dharti tere gadagar (Fakhra tawangar mawla) x2
Be dar tere dar pe akar (Hogaye buzar mawla) x2
Apna wazifa nade ali ko, subne banaa ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Pir fakir malang mawali, aur kalander saai) x2
Kambar mesum buzar salman (Malik-e ashtar aae) x2
Karte rahe hai karte rahe hai (Haider, haider saae) x2
Aaj bhi sindne mawla kadam ko, sar pe utha ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tera nara sunke mushkil, mushkil me parja ye) x2
Dushman-e imaan dekh kar tujko (Dharti me gar jaye) x2
Lakho ke lashkar se mawla (Tanha tu larjaye) x2
Tere khuda ne tujko apni teg bana ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tera ghar noorani mawla, ghar he tera noorani) x2
Tere ghar me jo surat he (Surat he qurani) x2
Tu kule imaane mawla (Zikr-e tere imaani) x2
Rabne tere nam se apna naam-e mila ke rakha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tere sakhi darbar he mawla, sari duniya jaane) x2
Koi khuda kehta hai koi (Saki ye kausar mane) x2
Koi nahi pehchana tujko (Sirf nabi pehchane) x2
Shehr ilm ne tujko apna, darjo banaa ke rakha hai
